question: What siRNA dose did Gao et al. use in their study?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%Gao%' OR text ILIKE '%FOXM1%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE (text ILIKE '%Gao et al%' OR text ILIKE '%Gao%') AND kind IN ('line','cell') ORDER BY page
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (6,7) AND line_no BETWEEN 1 AND 12 OR (page=6 AND text ILIKE '%dose%') OR (page=6 AND text ILIKE '%mg%') ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%siFOXM1%' OR text ILIKE '%si-FOXM1%' OR text ILIKE '%FOXM1%' OR text ILIKE '%CL4H6%' OR text ILIKE '%BT549%' ORDER BY page
SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p6.T2' AND row_no BETWEEN 1 AND 8 ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%nmol%' OR text ILIKE '%mg/kg%' OR text ILIKE '%mg kg%' OR text ILIKE '%µg%' OR text ILIKE '%ug/kg%' OR text ILIKE '%dose%' ORDER BY page, line_no
